units.source_text: 自此以后，小公子也更加重视东厅姐姐，和她亲近起来。

en.t: From then on, the young lord also came to value his elder sister in the east wing more highly and grew closer to her.

units.source_text: 过去他和异母的二姐反而常常见面，像同胞姐弟一样。

en.t: In the past, he had more often seen his second elder sister by another mother, and they had been like full siblings.

units.source_text: 但在这儿童的心目中，觉得东厅姐姐态度十分稳重，

en.t: But in this child's mind, his elder sister in the east wing seemed very composed in her manner,

units.source_text: 性情和蔼可亲，但愿她嫁得个好姐夫。

en.t: and gentle and easy to love by nature, so he hoped she would marry a good brother-in-law for him.

units.source_text: 如今大姐已嫁给皇太子，享受荣华富贵，

en.t: Now that his eldest sister had already married the Crown Prince and was enjoying splendor and wealth,

units.source_text: 这东厅姐姐却无人过问，他深为不满，觉得她很可怜。

en.t: while this elder sister in the east wing had no one paying her any attention, he was deeply dissatisfied and felt very sorry for her.

units.source_text: 他想：至少要让她嫁给这位匂皇子。

en.t: He thought, at the very least, she should be married to this Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 所以父亲叫他送梅花去，他很高兴。

en.t: So when his father told him to take plum blossoms there, he was delighted.

units.source_text: 然而这封信是答诗，应该送交父亲。

en.t: However, this letter was a reply poem and should have been handed over to his father.

units.source_text: 红梅大纳言看了诗，说道：“说这些话真没意思啊！

en.t: The Grand Counselor Kobai read the poem and said, "What a pointless thing to say!

units.source_text: 这匂皇子贪爱女色太过度了，知道我们不赞许他，

en.t: This Prince Niou is far too fond of women, and knowing that we do not approve of him,

units.source_text: 所以在夕雾右大臣及我们面前竭力抑制邪念，

en.t: he does his utmost to suppress his improper desires in front of Minister of the Right Yugiri and before us,

units.source_text: 装作一本正经，实在可笑。

en.t: putting on an air of perfect seriousness. It is truly laughable.

units.source_text: 一个十足的轻薄儿，勉强装作诚实人，

en.t: When a thoroughly frivolous fellow forces himself to act like an honest man,

units.source_text: 恐怕反而教人看不起吧。”

en.t: he will probably only make people look down on him all the more."
In this way, he criticized Prince Niou behind his back.

units.source_text: 今天他又派小公子入宫，再教他带一封信去，内有诗云：

en.t: Today he again sent the young lord to the palace and had him carry another letter, which contained this poem:
